Prin. Secy. Home ... on 31 May, 2024

Author: Shamim Ahmed
Bench: Shamim Ahmed
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:42152
Court No. - 27
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 5188 of 2024
Applicant :- Manoj Shukla @ Chhotu And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
.  And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Kumar Tiwari,Shiv Sinha Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shamim Ahmed,J.
Heard SriAshish Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

The applicants in the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C are seeking quashing of the Charge Sheet dated 12.01.2021 bearing Charge Sheet No. 01/2021 filed in Case Crime No. 443/2020 under sections 323, 498A and 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act at Police Station- Pali, District- Hardoi as well as entire proceeding of the case including the summoning order dated 31.01.2023 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court no.1, Hardoi in case no. 2803/2023 (State Versus Manoj Shukla @ Chhotu and others).

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court no.1, Hardoi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Submission of learned counsel for the applicants is that the matter relates to matrimonial dispute and the applicant has all the intentions to settle the same amicably.

Applicant's counsel strenuously urged that this case may be referred to the Mediation Centre of this Court so that the couple may have a chance to settle their dispute on their own terms through mediation.

The Court is also satisfied on the basis of the record and the submissions made before it that the nature of litigation is such that there is a chance to resolve the matter through process of mediation and an attempt ought to be made to explore that possibility.
Accordingly, the matter is being referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre, High Court,
Lucknow.

Learned counsel for the applicants will submit the certified copy of the this order alongwith the present application and affidavit within 3 weeks from today at the Mediation and Conciliation Centre and the Mediation and Conciliation Centre will issue notice to both the parties within a week thereafter fixing date in the case.
The mediator is allowed 2 months' time to find out possible solution of the dispute between the parties and send his report to the court regarding the outcome of mediation.
Put up this case on 30.09.2024 before appropriate Bench along with report of the mediator.

Till the next date of listing, the proceedings of theCharge Sheet dated 12.01.2021 bearing Charge Sheet No. 01/2021 filed in Case Crime No. 443/2020 under sections 323, 498A and 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act at Police Station- Pali, District- Hardoi as well as entire proceeding of the case including the summoning order dated 31.01.2023 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court no.1,
Hardoi in case no. 2803/2023 (State Versus Manoj Shukla @ Chhotu and others), shall be kept in abeyance in respect of the applicants, subject to the deposition of Rs.25,000/- as expenditure within 3 weeks by way of a bank draft to the Mediation Centre.

entities.text:
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court no.1,
Hardoi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is directed that out of Rs.25,000/-
deposited by the applicants, Rs.20,000/- shall be handed over to the opposite party no.2 on her first appearance and Rs.5,000/- shall be kept by the Mediation Centre.
This case shall not be treated as tied up or part heard with this Bench.

(Shamim Ahmed, J.) Order Date :- 31.5.2024 A.Nigam  Manoj Shukla @ Chhotu And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 31 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140914571/
